_comment: U1's metric 1 (first human reaction, any comment type) run on fixture_u2.sql, computed by hand: P-R2 (Q20) is 30 minutes here (the NORMAL comment) while time_to_first_review is 90 (the REVIEW row). Only the fields listed are compared. coderabbitai[bot] has is_bot = 0, so U1 counts its comments as human (Q19, Q23). Q55 (account cursor[bot], is_bot = 1, no branch mark) is other_bot and Q56 (a person) is no_marker; neither has a comment. Q57 to Q62 (D15 scenes: people, plain branches, empty body, no comment) are no_marker without a reaction: pr_count 45 + 6 = 51, reacted and the median do not change.
